dataset_metadata.purpose: Synthetic data for an AI support agent demo built around Brighterly-style accounts, lessons, tutors, subscriptions, billing, and support workflows.
dataset_metadata.privacy_note: All names, emails, IDs, payment details, and events are synthetic. No real credentials or payment card numbers are included.
dataset_metadata.demo_case_notes: confidence_score and priority are reference labels for the expected demo case; a live agent may calculate its own score from the incoming message and verified context. Headline demo candidate: BR-USER-002 (real duplicate charge, expected human-approved refund review).
dataset_metadata.support_history_notes: Support histories are intentionally varied across users and include billing, scheduling, technical, learning, tutor, subscription, and FAQ tickets.
changelog: duplicate_charge cases without a real duplicate are now case_type=duplicate_charge_false_alarm (agent must NOT open a ticket): BR-USER-017, BR-USER-047, BR-USER-077
child dates_of_birth corrected so age matches grade (grade K=5y, grade N=N+5y)
added user_message_variants (5 per user: casual, angry, short, detailed, multi_intent) to every primary_demo_case
added tool_catalog (14 MVP tools mapped to original tool names, with autonomy levels)
